verdict.rationale: Snyk Code is explicitly documented as a SAST solution with source-to-sink flow visualization (a hallmark of taint-based detection of vulnerability classes like injection/XSS) and CLI/IDE/CI integration for real-time scanning (snyk-docs-2, snyk-docs-3, snyk-docs-18, snyk-gh-5). No community evidence disputes Snyk Code's detection accuracy specifically (community complaints target dependency/PR tooling, not SAST). Missing for 10: explicit naming of injection/XSS as detected vulnerability classes and independent benchmark/hands-on validation of SAST detection quality.
